The '''annexation of the Qiilura system''' was an attempt by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] to take over the [[Qiilura system]]<ref name="MM" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]] itself had been the site of [[Mission to Qiilura|conflict]] much earlier in the war.<ref name="Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>
